**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  [General] Classify Jakarta JMS as emitting messaging metrics**

`instrumentation/jms/jms-3.0/metadata.yaml` is left with only `MESSAGING_SPANS`, although Jakarta JMS uses the same `JmsInstrumenterFactory` as this module and records send, receive, and process metrics, as covered by `AbstractJms3Test`. `YamlHelper.addMetadataProperties()` copies the categories from each module's own metadata rather than inferring them from emitted metrics, so regenerating the catalog will still omit Jakarta JMS from the new `MESSAGING_METRICS` classification. Add the tag to the JMS 3.0 metadata as part of this update too.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
